aiimage.custom.allow_private: Allow private-network endpoints on this server
aiimage.custom.allow_private_hint: Local servers such as Ollama or LM Studio run on this machine or your network. Link-local and cloud metadata addresses stay blocked. You can change this later in Model routing.
aiimage.custom.complete_previous: Complete the previous connection step first.
aiimage.custom.context_hint: Match the local runtime. Larger inputs use another eligible model; source text is never truncated.
aiimage.custom.endpoint_blocked: Link-local and cloud metadata addresses are always blocked.
aiimage.custom.endpoint_invalid: Use an allowed local endpoint ending in /v1, without credentials or query parameters.
aiimage.custom.key_saved: A key is saved. Leave this blank to keep it.
aiimage.custom.model_hint: Use the exact ID of a model already installed on the server.
aiimage.custom.model_invalid: Enter the exact ID of a model installed on the server, such as qwen3:8b.
aiimage.custom.modes_hint: Local only keeps every job on the offline placeholder, so it never calls this server.
aiimage.custom.modes_invalid: Choose at least one routing mode.
aiimage.custom.non_generation: Checks the installed model list. No prompt is sent and no content is generated.
aiimage.custom.private_off_admin: Turn on “Allow private-network endpoints” to connect a server on this machine or your network.
aiimage.custom.private_off_user: Ask an admin to allow private-network endpoints in Model routing before connecting a local server.
aiimage.custom.test_failed: The installed model could not be verified. Check the endpoint, model ID and key, then try again.
aiimage.custom.title: Add a custom provider
aiimage.custom.tokens_invalid: Use a context window of 4,096–1,048,576 tokens that is larger than the maximum output (256–16,384).
aiimage.decision.estimate_hint: Estimated spend per image call on your own key
aiimage.decision.images_unavailable: OpenAI images are not available for this key
aiimage.decision.images_unavailable_plac: OpenAI images are not available for this key; placeholder art keeps the flow working
aiimage.decision.images_verification: OpenAI needs organisation verification for images
aiimage.decision.images_verification_pla: OpenAI needs organisation verification for images; placeholder art keeps the flow working
aiimage.decision.local_only: Local only mode keeps art on the offline placeholder
aiimage.decision.placeholder: No connected model fits; placeholder art keeps the flow working
aiimage.form.invalid: Check the connection and model settings.
aiimage.routing.admin_only: Only an admin can change the routing mode and guards.
aiimage.routing.licence: Licence guard (non-commercial models on public series)
aiimage.routing.limit_amount: Monthly remote spend limit in US dollars
aiimage.routing.limit_invalid: Enter a monthly remote spend limit above $0, or switch the limit off.
aiimage.routing.no_decisions: Image jobs will show their model choices here.
aiimage.routing.pin_forbidden: You can pin models only for projects and characters you own.
aiimage.routing.private: Private-network endpoints (local servers such as Ollama)
aiimage.routing.save_failed: Routing was not saved. Reload the page and try again.
aiimage.routing.subtitle: How jobs pick a model on this server
aiimage.routing.target_hint: Project or character ID; leave empty for a server pin.
aiimage.routing.title: Routing
aiimage.routing.users: Users may add their own providers
aiimage.custom.blocked_title: Ask an admin to add this provider
aiimage.custom.blocked_body: Members can't add their own providers on this server. An admin can connect it for everyone, or allow members to add their own in Model routing.
aiimage.custom.comfy_server_hint: The address of a ComfyUI server on this machine or your network, such as http://192.168.1.40:8188.
aiimage.custom.server_invalid: Use an http or https address of a server on this machine or your network, without credentials or query parameters.
aiimage.custom.workflow_hint: Export the workflow from ComfyUI in API format. MangaVeyra fills in the prompt, seed and size for each run.
aiimage.custom.workflow_saved.one: {name} · {count} node. Choose a file only to replace it.
aiimage.custom.workflow_saved.other: {name} · {count} nodes. Choose a file only to replace it.
aiimage.custom.workflow_invalid: Choose a workflow exported with “Export (API)”: a JSON object of at most 512 nodes.
aiimage.custom.map_invalid: The workflow needs a text prompt input MangaVeyra can fill in. Check the input map.
aiimage.custom.comfy_found.one: NODE CHECK · {count} node on the server
aiimage.custom.comfy_found.other: NODE CHECK · {count} nodes on the server
aiimage.custom.comfy_non_generation: Checks that the server knows every node in the workflow and that none is a paid partner node. Nothing is generated.
aiimage.custom.comfy_failed: The server is missing a node of this workflow, an input is not mapped, or the workflow uses a paid partner node. Check the server and the workflow, then try again.
aiimage.custom.hf_where_hint: Serverless uses Hugging Face Inference Providers for text. A dedicated Inference Endpoint can serve text or images.
aiimage.custom.hf_endpoint_hint: Only for a dedicated endpoint: its https://…endpoints.huggingface.cloud address.
aiimage.custom.hf_endpoint_invalid: Use the https address of your Inference Endpoint on endpoints.huggingface.cloud.
aiimage.custom.hf_model_hint: Serverless: the model and the provider that serves it, such as Qwen/Qwen3-32B:together. Dedicated: the model repository.
aiimage.custom.hf_model_invalid: Enter owner/model, with :provider for serverless (for example Qwen/Qwen3-32B:together).
aiimage.custom.hf_non_generation: Checks the token and, for serverless text, that the provider serves the model with structured output at a listed rate. Nothing is generated.
aiimage.custom.hf_failed: The token, model or provider could not be verified. Serverless text needs a provider that supports structured output and lists its rate.
aiimage.custom.http_endpoint_hint: The URL MangaVeyra posts the request to, on this machine or your network.
aiimage.custom.template_hint: Placeholders: {list}. Values are inserted as JSON values, never as raw text.
aiimage.custom.template_invalid: Enter a JSON object that uses the prompt placeholder and only the listed placeholders.
aiimage.custom.image_path_hint: Where the image is in the JSON reply (or the final status), such as images.0 or result.url.
aiimage.custom.poll_hint: Polling only: where the status URL is in the first reply, the state field in each status reply, and its done and failed values. Status and image URLs must be on the same server.
aiimage.custom.check_url_hint: A health or status URL on the same server for the connection test. Blank checks the server's root.
aiimage.custom.paths_invalid: Check the image path and, when polling, the status URL path, state path and done value.
aiimage.custom.http_non_generation: Requests the check URL only. No prompt is sent and nothing is generated.
aiimage.custom.http_failed: The server did not answer the check URL. Check the address and the private-network setting, then try again.
aiimage.custom.commercial: Its model licence allows commercial use
aiimage.custom.commercial_hint: Leave off unless you know it does. With the licence guard on, public series never use a connection without commercial use.
aiimage.custom.size_invalid: Use sizes of 64–4,096 px and 1–4 images per run.
aiimage.custom.modes_hint_paid: Every Hugging Face call is paid, so it never joins Free only. Local only never calls it.
